topics: What is Economics?

chapters.name: Organisation of Data
topics: Meaning and types of variables
Frequency distribution

topics: Tabular presentation
Diagrammatic presentation: geometric forms (bar and pie diagrams)
Frequency diagrams: histogram, polygon and ogive
Arithmetic line graphs (time series graph)

chapters.name: Measures of Central Tendency
topics: Arithmetic mean
Median
Mode

topics: Meaning and properties; scatter diagram
Karl Pearson's method (two variables, ungrouped data)
Spearman's rank correlation (non-repeated and repeated ranks)

topics: Meaning and types: Wholesale Price Index, Consumer Price Index, index of industrial production
Uses of index numbers; inflation and index numbers

topics: Meaning of microeconomics and macroeconomics; positive and normative economics

topics: Revenue: total, average and marginal revenue and their relationship

topics: Perfect competition: features
